entries.source: Urkundenbuch des Cistercienserstiftes B. Mariae V. zu Hohenfurt in Böhmen, Nr. CLXV. , S. 208, CLXV.
entries.german:
1385. CO. 24. Jnni. 0. A0. — Johann von Rosenberg gibt den Cûterciensern in uohenfurt im Dorfe Zichraes sechs Lahne und im Dorf e Schild sechs Reute zu Eigen.

In nomine domini amen. Cuneta que geruntur in tempore, ne simiil cum eodem defluant, necesse est, ea scriptorum testimonio roborare. Quamobrem nos Johannes de Rosembergb �?o ram vniuersis tam presentibus quam futuris publice profitantes volumus esse notum, quod in naufragioso statu inter turbines peccatorum laboriosius decertantes adiuuante altissimo portum nitimur cerciorem, iuxta cousilium Danielis peccata elemosinis redimendo non per errorem aut inprouide, sed sana mentis vsi racione, ad honorem dei omnipo- tentis sueque genitricis gloriose virginis Marie et suorum sanctorum omnium laudem et in nostre ac felicis memorie fratris nostri dilec- tissimi domini Petri remedium animarum venerabilibus et religiosis fratribus ordinis Cisterciensis monasterii in Altouado iugiter deo famulantibus, per nostros predecessores ac progenitores dotato a radice sue fundaciouis generosius et erecto, in villa riostra Tyecho- raz sex laneos continente, qui omnes pro censu et aliis iuribus mi- nutis quinque talenta sex solidos et viginti denarios soluunt annuatim quinquaginta quinque pullos uel quinque solidos et quindecim dena- rios ac pro papauere sexaginta denarios, item in villa Schilt sex reyt seu mansos de Kalthprun ipsam villam Schilt intrando in manu dex- tera ordinario collocatos et omnes annuatim duas libras et duos solidos deuariorum censuantes, dare dignum duximus conferre ac liberaliter assignare prefatas vtilitates sine nostrorum successorum quolibet impedimento tenendum perpetue et habendum, et non per abbatem loci sed per pitantiarium dicti monasterii perpetuis tempo- ribus colligendum, de quo quidem censu idem pitantiarius non alias vtilitates fratrum et monasterii seu pitancie querendo, solum ex hoc nostro singulariter mandato in ecclesia ambitu dormitorio refectuario fratrum noua exstruendo, tecta deinceps tempore succedente in eis- dem locis antiqua tecta tenebitur cum diligenti studio reparare. In anniuersario nostro videlicet Johannis antefati de Rosembergh, quod ipsi fratres in dicto monasterio cum vigillis nouem leccionum et alia quauis exequiarum solempnitate velud pro aliis fundatoribus agi soient, perpetuis temporibus peragent, predictus pitanciarus pro 195 fratrum pitancia quindecim grossos ac inter inter communes pau- peres non sui huspitalis septuaginta denarios Wienenses et septua- ginta panes claustrales fideliter et caritatiue in domino Jargietur, et de pecuniis eiusdem census anfedictus pitantiarius coram abbate et conuentu mouasterii singulis annis tenebitur fidelem facere racio nem; et quidquid in ipsis rationibus remaneret de pecuniis predictis, hoc pro futuris temporibus ad ipsa tecta reseruare tenebitur pitan- ciarius antescriptus. Nos uero Vlricus et Henricus de Rosembergb, dum nos per mortem ipsius domini .lohaunis aut aliam resignacionem quod dominus deus diu auertere dignetur, vnus nostrum, quem pre- dicti fratris nostri karissimi bona occupare ex eius donacione et possidere continget, tune promittimus bona fide et sincera ac sine fraude, spondemus eciam sub fidei iuramento, quod prefato fratri nostro, dum in humanis ageret, ad sanctam prestitimus crucem, omnia premissa rata atque firma inuiolabiliter obseruare. Harum testimonio litterarum quibus sigillum nostrum cum prescriptorum fratrum nostrorum sigillis in robur et munimen de certa nostra sci- encia preseutibus sunt appensa. Sub anno domini millésimei trecen- tesimo octuagesimo quinta circa festum sancti Jobannis baptiste. Alle drei Siegel sind schon anderwärts beschrieben worden.
entries.english:
1385, about 24 June. Johann von Rosenberg gives the Cistercians at Hohenfurt six hides in the village of Zichraes and six farms in Schild as free property.

In the name of the Lord, amen. Since all things done in time must be confirmed by written testimony lest they pass away with time, therefore we, Johann von Rosenberg, publicly declare to all, present and future, that, striving through the help of the Most High for a surer harbor amid the shipwreck of sin, and following Daniel’s counsel to redeem sins through almsgiving, we have, not mistakenly or rashly but with sound judgment and after mature deliberation, for the honor of Almighty God, his glorious mother the Virgin Mary, and all the saints, and for the salvation of our soul and that of our beloved brother Lord Peter of blessed memory, deemed it right to give and freely assign to the venerable religious brothers of the Cistercian Order serving God continually at the monastery of Hohenfurt—endowed and generously established by our predecessors from its foundation—the following: in our village of Tyechora, six hides which together pay annually five talents, six solidi, and twenty denarii in rent and other small dues, fifty-five chickens or five solidi and fifteen denarii, and sixty denarii for poppy; and in Schild, six farms or holdings of Kalthprun, situated on the right as one enters the village, which together pay annually two pounds and two solidi in rent. We grant these revenues to be held forever, without hindrance from any of our successors, and to be collected not by the abbot but by the monastery’s almoner.

The almoner shall use the revenues solely, by our special command, to build new roofs for the church, cloister, dormitory, and refectory, and thereafter diligently to repair the old roofs in those places. On the anniversary of the aforesaid Johann von Rosenberg, the brothers shall forever commemorate him in the monastery with a vigil of nine lessons and the other funeral solemnities customary for founders. The almoner shall faithfully and charitably distribute for the brothers’ meal 15 groschen, and among the common poor who are not of his hospital 70 Viennese denarii and 70 convent loaves. Each year the almoner must render a faithful account of this rent before the abbot and convent; any money remaining shall be reserved for future repairs to those roofs.

We, Ulrich and Henricus von Rosenberg, promise in good faith, sincerely, without fraud, and under the oath of faith we swore at the holy cross to our brother while he lived, that if Lord Johann dies or, which God long avert, resigns, whichever of us receives and possesses our dear brother’s property by his grant will faithfully and inviolably observe all the foregoing. These letters bear our seals and those of our aforementioned brothers, attached in confirmation with our certain knowledge. In the year 1385, around the feast of Saint John the Baptist.

All three seals hanging from parchment strips have been described elsewhere.
